repository_ledger_location.designation_source: org-contract.json organization_ledger_ref (StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter#368 issuecomment-6092785329); preserves_repo_receipt: true; StegVerse-org/.github#118
repository_ledger_location.rule: The repository chain is kept in its own subtree of the designated organization ledger ref, published by the same fast-forward push under ORGANIZATION_LEDGER_LOCK. Repository replay walks repository-ledger/<repository>/HEAD.json back through its own receipts and never reads an organization receipt. Repository receipts minted before this location was bound (previous_receipt_sha256 null, retained under source-receipts/) are history, not the head of this chain.
